svg.title: Issue 3 — Page 1 — Panel 2: MED Theodore sweeping near his bench
svg.desc: MED 50mm eye level. Theodore mid-sweep near his small back-corner bench. Behind him a scrap of cloth on the bench laid with a disassembled pocket watch movement in an ordered grid. His attention is on the watch movement, not the floor. Warm amber gaslight; back corner dimmer than main workshop. CRIBBAGE off-panel orders solder melt.
